holderQuote: Numbtongue didn’t know why he’d gained the [Electric Chords] Skill or, as he’d become a Level 25 Bard, [Lightning Melody].

Thoughts like that made Numbtongue’s head hurt, so he played another riff on his guitar. Fine, [Electric Chords] was a good ability to have, even if using a guitar in combat wasn’t the smartest of life choices.
Numbtongue played a riff. Sparks of lightning shot from his guitar, grounding themselves on the cave floor.

holderQuote: His random strumming became intentional. He began to play a quick, snappy tune. And the sound that came from his guitar changed.
effectQuote: the chords changed to something almost approaching the crackling of thunder
